data.title: Milos Residences
data.about:
Milos is a luxurious new project by Deca Properties. It is located in the Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) and offers exquisite 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments across 13 floors. Each apartment at Milos Residences for Sale in Dubai Land Dubai is meticulously designed to reflect modern elegance and comfort. It features poolside balconies and terraces for a serene escape with stunning views of the Dubai skyline.

Residents can enjoy seamless access to Business Bay, Downtown Dubai, and the new Al Maktoum International Airport. The complex of DLRC boasts facilities such as an outdoor cinema, state-of-the-art gym, swimming pool, and dedicated kids' play area, ensuring all needs are met within the community. With excellent connectivity to Dubai’s main business hubs and recreational centers, MILOS Residences promises a life of unparalleled comfort and convenience.

characteristics_module.title: Milos in Dubai Land Offers Easy Access to Luxury Living
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Rent-to-own concept with an 8-year payment plan, including 5 Years Post-Handover.
  • Pay monthly instalments as low as 0.66% to own your dream home.
  • 195 exquisitely designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments ranging from 640 to 1,642 square feet.
  • Benefit from top-notch amenities like an outdoor cinema, state-of-the-art gym, swimming pool, and kids' play area.
  • The development features a well-planned B+G+13 structure, providing a safe and contemporary living environment.
  • Close to Al-Habtoor Polo Resort, Dubai Outlet Mall, Sheikh Zayed University, and other facilities.

location_tile.title: Stay Close to the Vibrant Pulse of the City While Enjoying a Tranquil Lifestyle
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Milos Residences is ideally situated in the heart of Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), a prime and rapidly growing area in New Dubai. DLRC is strategically positioned along the Dubai – Al Ain Road (E66) and Emirates Road (E611), providing excellent connectivity and accessibility to major business hubs and key areas within the emirate.

The surrounding area of DLRC is rich with world-class amenities and attractions, making Milos Residences an ideal choice for modern families and professionals alike.

7 minutes to Dubai Outlet Mall
10 minutes to Sheikh Zayed University
10 minutes to IMG Worlds of Adventure
12 minutes to Global Village
20 minutes to Burj Khalifa
